profile.headline: Actively looking for Software Engineer position
profile.summary: A U.S. Citizen, Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and building scalable full-stack applications, microservices, and distributed systems using Java, Spring Boot, Python, C++, React.js, Node.js, Angular, REST APIs, Apache Kafka, SQL, and cloud technologies. Experienced in developing secure, high-performance enterprise solutions across banking, financial services, and manufacturing domains, leveraging AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and CI/CD to deliver reliable cloud-native applications. Hands-on experience implementing AI-assisted solutions using Amazon Bedrock, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, and AWS Lambda to improve operational efficiency and system reliability. Strong collaborator with expertise in system design, API development, cloud architecture, performance optimization, Agile delivery, and cross-functional teamwork to build scalable software that drives business value.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected cloud-native portfolio servicing and trade processing microservices using Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, to modernize legacy custody workflows into resilient distributed services, enabling real-time processing of 12M+ trade and settlement events daily for global investment operations and institutional clients. 
• Engineered AI-assisted operational intelligence using Python, Amazon Bedrock, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, vector embeddings, and prompt engineering, to provide contextual incident analysis, production runbook recommendations, and enterprise knowledge retrieval for support engineers, reducing MTTR by 38% and improving operational decision making across mission-critical trading platforms. 
• Developed secure RESTful APIs and Backend-for-Frontend services using Spring Boot, Node.js, Express.js, GraphQL, React.js, TypeScript, and Redux, to streamline portfolio management, asset servicing, and reconciliation workflows, improving application response times by 32% for operations analysts and relationship managers. 
• Implemented event-driven data processing pipelines using Apache Kafka, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, CloudWatch, and EventBridge, to automate reconciliation, exception handling, and downstream notifications across distributed systems, improving transaction visibility while eliminating thousands of manual operational tasks for finance and settlement teams. 
• Optimized cloud infrastructure and platform reliability using AWS EKS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, and GitHub Actions, to standardize CI/CD pipelines, automate deployments, and strengthen production observability, improving deployment reliability and minimizing service disruption during production releases while increasing deployment frequency by 45% across multiple engineering teams. 
• Collaborated with product managers, solution architects, cybersecurity, compliance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed scalable backend microservices using Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL, to modernize payment processing and account servicing platforms into distributed systems, enabling secure processing of over 8 million financial transactions daily for retail and commercial banking customers. 
• Designed secure RESTful APIs and event-driven services using Spring Boot, Kafka, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, to support real-time payment authorization, fraud detection, and transaction notifications, improving end-to-end processing latency by 35% while increasing platform availability for digital banking applications. 
• Built responsive customer-facing applications using React.js, TypeScript, Redux, JavaScript, Node.js, and Express.js, to deliver self-service dashboards for payments, account activity, and transaction history, improving user engagement and reducing customer support requests for online banking users. 
• Optimized enterprise CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Git, Maven, SonarQube, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, to automate build validation, security scanning, container deployment, and release management, reducing deployment time by 45% and improving software delivery reliability for multiple engineering teams. 
• Strengthened platform resilience by implementing distributed caching, asynchronous messaging, centralized logging, and production monitoring using Redis, Kafka, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch, to improve system observability, accelerate incident diagnosis, and enhance production stability for mission-critical payment services. 
• Partnered with solution architects, product owners, cybersecurity teams, QA engineers, and business stakeholders throughout Agile delivery cycles, translating regulatory and business requirements into scalable technical solutions while participating in architecture reviews, code reviews, production releases, and post-deployment support for enterprise.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed scalable backend services using Java 11, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and Docker, to modernize manufacturing and connected vehicle platforms into modular microservices, improving service reliability and reducing API response time by 30% for engineering and manufacturing operations. 
• Built responsive web applications using React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, HTML5, and CSS3, to provide real-time visibility into vehicle production, inventory, and quality metrics, enabling plant engineers and operations teams to make faster data-driven decisions across multiple manufacturing facilities. 
• Implemented event-driven integration services using Apache Kafka, Redis, and SQL, to synchronize production events, inventory updates, and supply chain transactions across distributed enterprise systems, improving data consistency and supporting uninterrupted manufacturing workflows during peak production cycles. 
• Automated cloud-native deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and Git, to standardize application builds, container orchestration, and release automation, reducing deployment effort by 40% while improving release quality for development and QA teams. 
• Optimized database performance through SQL tuning, indexing strategies, query optimization, and data modeling across PostgreSQL and SQL Server, to accelerate operational reporting and backend transaction processing, improving data retrieval performance by 25% for business users and production support teams. 
• Collaborated with product owners, solution architects, QA engineers, DevOps teams, and manufacturing stakeholders throughout Agile sprints, translating business requirements into scalable software solutions while participating in system design, code reviews, unit testing, production support, and root cause analysis to improve application stability and delivery quality.
